atoms.a: In this presentation, I will be discussing the impact that social media has on modern society. It is clear that social media is prominent in everything we do, from what we buy online and how we decide to dress, to what music we listen to and the food we eat. It is culturally significant in a number of ways.

You'll never guess what happened to me today! Remember that competition I entered a while ago? Well, I’m the winner! I won a new laptop and a pair of headphones. That’s so good, isn’t it? I can’t wait for them to arrive at my house, I’ve been waiting to find out if I won for ages!
